title: ASML introduces dual wafer stage technology on its TWINSCAN 300 mm lithography platform

passages.locator: Exhibit p. 1, dateline and opening five paragraphs
passages.note: ASML announces dual independent stages on its AT:750 KrF and AT:400 i-line scanners, with the stages swapping after parallel measurement and exposure. ASML gives 300 mm wafer support and describes ArF and 157 nm as later platform extensions.

lineage: The USPTO record preserves a printout of ASML’s release captured 16 April 2021. The announcement date appears in the original article dateline.
